sourceRefs.locator: ER 903, About the source: September 506, Caesarius, Alaric’s permission and the representation of absent bishops by priests and deacons.
pp. 43–47, 56–61: date of the battle, Alaric’s death, Gregory’s tenth milestone and rival identifications at Vouillé and Voulon.

summary.de: Er erlaubte den nizänischen Bischöfen 506, in Agde zu tagen. Im folgenden Jahr fiel er im Kampf bei Poitiers.
summary.en: He permitted the Nicene bishops to meet at Agde in 506. He fell in battle near Poitiers the following year.
